landing.securitySectionCoverageDesc: Devin automatically analyzes every PR for vulnerabilities, reasoning across your entire codebase to catch the auth bypasses and logic flaws that pattern-matching scanners miss.
landing.securitySectionTriagingDesc: Each finding is ranked by severity and tagged with a CWE ID for easy triaging.
landing.securitySectionFixesDesc: Beyond flagging issues, Devin writes the fix directly and opens it as a merge-ready PR, so it arrives ready for an engineer to review instead of a ticket that waits weeks in a queue.
landing.exampleSectionText: Adds a password-change route to the account service so users can update their credentials.
landing.exampleFindingTitle: Password-change endpoint lacks ownership or admin authorization checks
landing.exampleFindingDescription: The new `POST /api/users/password` handler accepts any `username` and `password` after `secureFnc`, but never verifies that the authenticated request user is the same account (or an admin) before calling `setUsers`. In this codebase `verifyToken` also creates a guest token when no `x-access-token` is supplied (`jwt-helper.js:46-65`), so an unauthenticated/guest request can reach this handler and reset any known user's password, resulting in account takeover.
landing.exampleFindingRecommendation: Require a valid authenticated non-guest user for this route, verify `req.userId === req.body.username` for self-service changes (or require admin permission for resets), and verify the current password before writing the new password. Reject guest/unauthenticated requests and avoid disclosing whether arbitrary usernames exist if possible.
